methods_quotes.q: The national and regional baselines are the mean percentage of visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks for the previous three seasons plus two standard deviations.
The epidemic threshold is set at 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
The seasonal baseline proportion of P&I deaths is projected using a robust regression procedure
Cumulative unadjusted incidence rates are calculated using CDC’s National Center for Health Statistics population estimates
National and regional percentages of patient visits for ILI are weighted on the basis of state population.
Activity levels are based on the percentage of outpatient visits in a jurisdiction attributed to ILI
